description: Sign cleartext messages using NIST P-256 / P-384 elliptic-curve keys in WebCrypto and output an ASCII-armored verification block.

seo.metaTitle: PGP / ECDSA armored message signer — 100% Private In-Browser Utility | PrivacyFold
seo.metaDescription: Sign cleartext messages using NIST P-256 / P-384 elliptic-curve keys in WebCrypto and output an ASCII-armored verification block. Runs 100% locally in your browser via /wasm/crypto/pgp-crypto-v1.wasm with zero file uploads.
seo.aeoSummary: PGP / ECDSA armored message signer processes files and text entirely inside your browser tab using /wasm/crypto/pgp-crypto-v1.wasm (Tier D). Zero bytes are uploaded to any server.

faqs.q: Does PGP / ECDSA armored message signer upload my files or text to a server?
faqs.a: No. PGP / ECDSA armored message signer executes 100% inside your browser's local memory using /wasm/crypto/pgp-crypto-v1.wasm. No data leaves your device.

faqs.q: Can AI agents or CLI scripts automate PGP / ECDSA armored message signer?
faqs.a: Yes. Use Lane A schema /schemas/pgp_crypto.json or open /tools/pgp-crypto?mode=agent#payload with input[data-pf='input'] and window.__PRIVACYFOLD_RESULT__.
